desc:
🏡 Mini City RP is a Brazilian roleplay game, which started its development in early 2020. The roleplay offers an immersive experience for those who want to have fun, create stories, and connect with other players. 

💼 Work as a street cleaner, farmer, delivery driver, doctor, and many other jobs. You can also be a police officer and bring order to the city, or pursue a life of crime and create your own gang to dominate the city. 

📕 Follow the roleplay rules! The rules are on our server below. 

🎮 We support all platforms (Computer, Mobile, and Console).

⚠️ Need help? Open a ticket on our server and our team will help you!
